headline: F-Droid Releases Its Biggest Update in a Decade
summary: F-Droid rebuilt its Android app store from the ground up with a new UI, its biggest update in a decade, according to Ars Technica and The Register. The Register frames the overhaul as coming while Google tightens restrictions on Android sideloading.

claims.statement: F-Droid released its biggest update in a decade, rebuilding its app store with a new UI.

sources.quote: F-Droid gets its biggest update in a decade with new UI and smoother app installs
F-Droid's Android app store has been rebuilt from the ground up.
the FOSS app market is rolling out a huge overhaul

claims.statement: The update comes as Google tightens restrictions on Android sideloading.
